h:
HR Beautify（“HR”代表 Hires 或高分辨率）是一种先进的 ComfyUI 工作流程，用于优化原始放大图像。它不包括通常的高档人工智能模型组件，而是专注于尽可能对高档员工图像进行最佳细化，并可选择通过风格转换来美化它们。


该工作流程包括两个 ControlNet，用于提供最强大和灵活的 img2img 指导，以及两个 IP 适配器，用于通过风格转换和构图或参考指导来增强图像。为了进一步完善，还包括 Power Lora Loader 节点，支持可能无限数量的细节或风格 LoRas。工作流程中还包括三个后处理组件：增强图像的 HDR 范围、高级图像锐化和颜色匹配。

支持 img2img 精炼的平铺组件是广泛使用的 Tiled Diffusion (TD) 以及 Tiled VAE Encode & Decode。 TD 与所有 ControlNet 模型兼容，可协助处理高达24K分辨率，可选地在输出中添加创意细节。


该工作流程包括带有用户控制参数描述的注释。 HR Beautify 工作流程及其使用的自定义节点的完整描述可以在github 维基页面项目的。要查看使用 HR Beautify 工作流程精炼的员工图像的更多示例并下载嵌入该图像的全尺寸 png 文件，请单击这里.

o.en:
HR Beautify (‘HR’ stands for Hires, or High resolution) is an advanced ComfyUI workflow to refine raw upscaled images. It doesn’t include the usual upscale with AI model component, concentrating instead on the best refinement of upscaled hires images possible, optionally beautifying them with a style transfer.


The workflow includes two ControlNets, for the most powerful and flexible img2img guidance, and two IP Adapters, to enhance images with style transfer and composition or reference guidance. For extra refinement, the Power Lora Loader node is included, supporting a potentially unlimited number of detail or style LoRas. Also included in the workflow are three post processing components: enhancing image’s HDR range, advanced image sharpening and color-matching.

The tiling component that enables hires img2img refining is the widely used Tiled Diffusion (TD), together with Tiled VAE Encode & Decode. TD is compatible with all ControlNet models and can assist in processing images of up to24Kresolution, optionally adding creative detail in the output along the way.


The workflow includes a note with description of the user-controlled parameters. Full description of the HR Beautify workflow and custom nodes it uses can be found on thegithub wiki pagesof the project. To view more examples of hires images refined with the HR Beautify workflow and download full-size png files embedding it, clickhere.
